title: Looks great, works not so great.
text: Looks great, works not so great.. Actually pretty hard to use.  You have to get the teeth positioned perfectly to open a beer.  Looks super awesome, but not the easiest to actually use.

product_metadata.title: Brothers Star Trek: USS Enterprise Bottle Opener
features: Brothers Star Trek: USS Enterprise Bottle Opener
description: Sit back, put your Spock ears on and watch some classic episodes or the new Star Trek film — and what goes better with Star Trek than a nice, cold beer. Fear not, Trekkies, with the release of the USS Enterprise Bottle Opener, now you can open those chilled beers in true Trek style.
